# #230 Staple lists replace the random slot pick ## Parent
#224
## What to build
Each movement slot carries an ordered list of Staple exercises (ADR 054). Generation prescribes the first staple the player's Equipment access allows, and the next staples become that exercise's suggested substitutes. The weighted random top-three pick is removed, so the same profile always produces the same program. Staple lists favour stretch-biased variants where the library has them.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Vertical pull prescribes the Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown for a Commercial gym player - [ ] Every slot has an ordered staple list; the first allowed by Equipment access is prescribed - [ ] The next staples on the list are offered as that exercise's suggested substitutes - [ ] Generating twice for an identical profile produces an identical program - [ ] Stretch-biased variants rank ahead where available (e.g. seated leg curl before lying, overhead cable extension beside pushdowns, incline DB curl beside preacher curls) - [ ] ADR 011's code references and rules still hold except where ADR 054 amends them
